rationale: Canonical typed graph/map/ranking is main-adopted. Caller-selected map/source Planning, scoped source search and opt-in native navigation are feature-only. Native28 availability/scripted tests are not actual Qwen map use (none in original run). SnapshotDelta is exported/tested with no maintained non-test consumer; Localization has internal fact consumers but no complete native witness-resolution loop. Any next capability must choose one real bounded consumer, preserve retained-source/edit authority and distinguish policy-effectiveness research from API adoption.
duplicate_disposition: Reuse original pending record and parent. No payload, approval, status, grant, B-number or experiment judgment changes. Detailed source/custody identities are in the companion audit manifest.
